description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to understand the file-based task management system architecture. (2) Locate `/workspace/.openclaw/workspace/` and understand its structure (ACTIVE-TASKS.md, CLOSED-TASKS.md, projects/). (3) Read `/workspace/data-pipeline-migration-notes.txt` for project context. (4) Create `/workspace/.openclaw/workspace/projects/data-pipeline-migration/progress.md` with ALL 5 mandatory sections per SKILL.md: 基本信息, 进度检查清单 (with checkboxes), 关键决策与规则, 文件位置, and 下次开始时需要知道的 (with exactly 3-5 bullet memo items). (5) Ensure ACTIVE-TASKS.md has a row for data-pipeline-migration (it already has a stub row — agent should update/confirm it). (6) Archive api-redesign: MOVE (not copy) `projects/api-redesign/` to `projects/_archive/api-redesign/` (preserving progress.md). (7) Remove the api-redesign row from ACTIVE-TASKS.md. (8) Add api-redesign to CLOSED-TASKS.md. (9) Leave infra-monitoring-setup untouched in both ACTIVE-TASKS.md and its project folder. The key proprietary traps: the 5-section structure with 3-5 bullets in the memo section, the specific _archive subdirectory path, and the dual update to both ACTIVE and CLOSED task indexes.
